author: Anas
html:
Nice article.
I have a very little note. The article title says “With Redis” although the article is focusing more on the different rate limiting patterns. I have no idea whether you are planning to post a second part that talk about implementation with Redis or not. If you are planning to do that, I suggest to add a statement at the end of the article to inform the reader to wait for the second part for specific implementation with Redis.

author: Raphael De Lio
html: Hey, Anas! Thanks for the suggestion, that’s indeed the case. I’ll add a note informing that the following parts will be coming out weekly.
